meta.name: Xzibit App Standard
meta.description: Design tokens for all Xzibit apps. Derived from Brand System v2.0, with light-canvas + humanist interpretation.

rules.case: sentence case for all headings and labels
rules.uppercase: ONLY the small '.step' label (Step 1 · Planning) uses uppercase with 0.18em tracking
rules.italic: avoid in UI; reserve for editorial quotes

components.summary: All components inherit tokens above. For visual and code reference, open /standards.html.

pill.rule: background uses status-50, text uses status-700

branding: The only accent colour across the entire app is teal (#19B1A1).
Fonts: Inter for everything. Sentence case for all headings.
Xzibit 'X' wordmark uses the teal→teal-600 gradient mark.
Keep the brand presence light — accent, never chrome-dominating.
status: Use only the six-pastel status family (mint / sky / amber / coral / lilac / sun) for chrome.
Each status always uses its own 50-weight background + 500-weight border/dot + 700-weight text.
Charts and data-viz inside a container may extend beyond these; chrome may not.
layout: Spacing snaps to the 4/8 ladder. Don't use arbitrary pixel values.
Radii snap to xs/sm/md/lg/xl/pill. Don't invent new ones.
Cards and panels have soft shadows (sm). Floating elements use the float shadow.
typography: No ALL CAPS headings. The only uppercase token is '.step' (small tracked eyebrow).
Headings use sentence case and bold weight (600–700).

shipChecklist: Stylesheet <link> to xzibit-design.css is the first CSS loaded.
Canvas is white or surface-soft. Sidebar is white with 1px hairline right border.
Inter is the single font. No League Spartan in body copy.
Headings are sentence case. No ALL CAPS except small 'Step 1' eyebrow labels.
Teal #19B1A1 is the single brand accent — primary button, active nav, focus rings.
Status uses the six-pastel family only. No bespoke reds, greens, blues elsewhere in chrome.
Shift/event blocks use 4px coloured left border + pastel-50 fill + 10px radius.
Empty slots are 1.5px dashed outlines that turn teal on hover.
Buttons are pill-shaped. Primary has the soft teal shadow.
All radii snap to tokens. All spacing snaps to the 4/8 ladder.
